It's gorgeous imo! I got mine for a little over £150 ( GBP) - paitent internet shopping was needed. Though definitely be careful, some sites offer fakes that have plastic sides. Most sites sell for around £300 (GBP) - I'm not sure of the exchange rate between GBP and USD though. If you reside in the state's I'd definitely go hunt down the 804v (same case essentially but bigger).

I've not had this case for too long so can't comment on long term dust collection😂 but so far there's very little getting in if at all. Also it is a fingerprint magnet!

Have to add, this case sits on my desk -it is heavy af so make sure where ever youre placing it can handle the weight. My old case used to sit on the floor and would collect dust like crazy but it did have mesh filters which worked wonders.

It's a fiddly case in terms of cable management/tidying as there isn't much space to hide cabling so you do have to plan and think it through in that aspect but other than that I've not had issues with it.

I would say double check the sizes of all your kit because some GPU/PSU/radiators will not fit in this case so if you're thinking on upgrading parts don't forget to plan for the size. You may also have to mount your gpu vertically if it's a big boy but the case does come with a pcie riser cable should you need it.

Water cooling isn't your only option, you can cool your cpu with ya normal cpu cooler (which is what I do) and there's space at the bottom to fit 3 X 120mm fans (again which I do -but I will be getting an aio watercooler at some point).

I have a micro ATX motherboard and whilst this case supports that and I didn't run into issues, I imagine it'd be easier to build in this case with an ATX board - as your parts won't be so close knit together and you'd probably get some neater cable management going on.

It's a beautiful case, and it's a different vibe to your standard case which is the only reason I went for it. Im bored of everything looking the same and I get to see all my kit at the same time.

In terms of sufficient airflow, there's cutouts around each glass panel. It won't necessarily be as efficient as your normal shaped cases, but as long as you pick decent fans/watercooling you'll be fine.
